title: Causal localization of becoming
primary_question: What is the earliest causally verified transition at which continued viable realization without the new organization becomes impossible?

unknowns: relevant class of force or adversity

frozen_operational_definition.tada_moment: The earliest resolved transition where a viable continuation without the candidate new organization exists immediately before, none exists immediately after, ablation removes the new capacity or viability, and restoration restores it.

primary_hypothesis.h1: At least one developmental history contains a reproducible causal boundary satisfying BEFORE, AFTER, NECESSITY, and RESTORATION.
primary_hypothesis.h0: No transition satisfies all four conditions under matched replay and declared future-space coverage.

secondary_hypotheses: The boundary may occur at different clock times or physical connections while preserving a common causal closure signature.
Consequential adversity predicts closure only when the prior organization is no longer causally sufficient and continued viability remains possible.
The transition may be distributed across a minimal necessary set rather than localized to one atomic event.
procedure: Generate or select developmental histories without inspecting target outcomes.
From each pre-transition snapshot, enumerate or sample continuations under the frozen intervention policy.
Classify viable continuations using the preregistered criterion.
Test whether any viable continuation remains without the candidate organization.
Ablate only the transition-specific organizational change and replay matched controls.
Restore or reconstruct the change and replay.
Repeat across seeds, histories, environments, and resolutions.
Return the earliest boundary passing all four required conditions.

outcome_classes.TADA_POINT: One resolved transition passes all four conditions.
outcome_classes.TADA_INTERVAL: The boundary is bounded but current resolution cannot isolate one transition.
outcome_classes.DISTRIBUTED_BECOMING: No atomic transition passes, but a minimal necessary transition set does.
outcome_classes.NO_CLOSURE: The capacity appears without demonstrated loss of all viable continuations outside the new organization.
outcome_classes.UNRESOLVED: Instrumentation or future-space coverage is insufficient.
outcome_classes.FALSIFIED_FOR_SYSTEM: Matched evidence contradicts necessity, restoration, or closure.

claim_rule: Do not claim a TADA moment from observation alone. A claim requires causal ablation and restoration under matched replay.
universal_claim_rule: No cross-system law may be claimed until the same invariant predicts held-out transitions in materially different systems.
